title: Earth of Joy_10477M
official: Evaluation of the Effects of the Earth of Joy Educational Kit on Children's Well-being and Empathy at School
summary: Study to evaluate the effect of the Terre de Joie educational kit on children's well-being and empathy at school
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Volunteer teachers who have not yet experienced Earth of Joy in the classroom
* Teachers of students in Grade 4. Mixed-grade classrooms are also eligible, including Grade 3/4 and Grade 4/5 combinations
* Children aged between 7 and 11
* Children able to read French

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal of parents or child
